decision.reason: [ev-95495ad6803b] is a one-line changelog entry. It says only that the KustomizeImage Match function was fixed so that newly added unit tests pass. It does not say what Match got wrong before or what it does now, which image specifications or Kustomize configurations are affected, or what an operator sees if they do nothing. To write the typed assertion, we need the content of PR #21872 or commit 563ccb20 showing the before and after matching behaviour.
